section_heading: 3.6 TUGS/VESSEL ASSISTANCE AND/OR ATTENDANCE (continued) and 3.7 MISCELLANEOUS TUG/VESSEL SERVICES
plain_summary: This page details various surcharges and conditions applicable to tug/vessel assistance services, including fees for services outside ordinary working hours, additional tugs, vessels without their own power, and cancellations. It also specifies fees for delays in vessel arrival or departure. Additionally, the page introduces miscellaneous tug/vessel services such as tanker fire watch, fire fighting, and general standby services, outlining hourly rates and maximum charges for different time periods.
